menuItems.name: Sourdough Margherita Pizza
menuItems.description: Tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, fresh basil, and virgin olive oil on hand-stretched sourdough crust.

menuItems.name: Paneer Tikka Pizza
menuItems.description: Clay-oven spiced paneer chunks, bell peppers, red onions, coriander, and mint-mayo drizzle.

menuItems.name: Cheese Lava Burger
menuItems.description: Crispy veggie patty stuffed with liquid cheddar, topped with caramelized onions and signature sauce.

menuItems.name: Maharaja Paneer Burger
menuItems.description: Double layer spiced paneer slabs, iceberg lettuce, tomatoes, and tandoori dressing.

menuItems.name: Tandoori Paneer Momos
menuItems.description: Dumplings stuffed with spiced paneer, charred in clay oven, served with spicy red chili chutney.

menuItems.name: Peri Peri French Fries
menuItems.description: Golden skin-on french fries tossed in an aromatic, fiery peri-peri seasoning blend.

menuItems.name: Elaichi Cutting Chai
menuItems.description: Traditional street-style tea brewed with freshly crushed ginger, green cardamom, and milk.

menuItems.name: Rose & Honey Specialty Latte
menuItems.description: A student favorite! Double shot of aromatic Arabica espresso, steamed milk, organic honey infusion, and fresh rose petal garnish. Sweet, warm, and highly energizing.

menuItems.name: Belgian Chocolate Shake
menuItems.description: Thick shake made with 70% dark Belgian chocolate gelato, topped with brownie chunks.

menuItems.name: Blue Lagoon Mocktail
menuItems.description: Refreshing summer drink with blue curacao syrup, freshly squeezed lime juice, mint leaves, and soda.

menuItems.name: Sourdough Pesto Sandwich
menuItems.description: House-made basil pesto, fresh tomatoes, creamy mozzarella cheese, grilled on artisan sourdough.

reviews.name: Aarav Sharma
reviews.review: Zoop Cafe is our go-to hangout spot. The Rose Latte is out of this world, and the aesthetic is insanely cozy. Perfect place to code or catch up with friends.

reviews.name: Neha Kapoor
reviews.review: From the glassmorphic cards to the curated menu, Zoop is perfect. The Cheesy Lava Burger is loaded and super delicious!

selfieWall.name: Preeti & Sarthak

selfieWall.review: Obsessed with the aesthetics here! Perfect lighting for selfies.
